answer: Allow reading initialize-time clientInfo, never live connection state. ADR-0007 bans identity-from-connection for agent/session identification (stateless server, identified from request _meta and hook payloads). clientInfo from the initialize handshake is a one-time value sent by the client itself, cached, not polled live from the socket — it is used for client/platform detection (adapter routing), not for agent/session identity or auth. Archaeology shows the v1 fix for #542/#539 (eec0861e, 7e67952c, 8b9d13a1 and the #542/#539 commit chain) added exactly this: map initialize clientInfo.name to the right adapter (e.g. 'omp-coding-agent' -> OMP adapter) because env-var/config-dir detection alone misidentified clients. Following ADR-0007 literally and dropping clientInfo read reopens #542/#539 (client misdetection regression). The rule's real target is live connection state used for identity/security decisions, not a cached handshake value used for routing. Recommend ADR-0007 be amended to say: never read identity off the connection; clientInfo captured once at initialize may be cached and used only for client/platform detection, never as the source of agent or session identity.
evidence: docs/v2/adr/0007-mcp-spec-version.md: 'The agent and the session are identified from request _meta and hook payloads, never from the connection' (stateless decision #4). git -C cm-main log -S 'clientInfo' --oneline shows eec0861e 'fix(detect): map omp-coding-agent clientInfo to omp adapter (closes #542 partial - 1 of 6)' and chain 92a6f2a6/7e67952c/a9869a60/1616f0bb for #542, and 466d5b5f/f8913eac/8b9d13a1/0ff24134 for #539, all using initialize-time clientInfo for adapter/platform detection, not security identity. git show eec0861e confirms the commit body: 'Pi rebranded to OMP. Current upstream clientInfo.name omp-coding-agent ... now resolves to the OMP adapter.' No mention of clientInfo vs ADR-0007 conflict found in DECISIONS-r3.md or TECH-SPEC.md (grep returned only an unrelated TECH-SPEC.md:226 table row).

finding.claim: ADR-0007 states identity is never read from the connection, but does not say whether a cached initialize-time clientInfo value may still be used for client/platform detection (the mechanism v1 used to fix #542/#539).
finding.evidence: ADR-0007 decision #4: 'The agent and the session are identified from request _meta and hook payloads, never from the connection.' git log -S 'clientInfo' in cm-main shows the v1 #542/#539 fixes (eec0861e, 7e67952c, 8b9d13a1, 0ff24134, etc.) read clientInfo.name from the initialize handshake to select the adapter, with no other reliable signal available.
finding.fix: Add a line to ADR-0007 distinguishing 'identity' (agent/session identity, security-relevant, must come from _meta/hook payloads) from 'client/platform detection' (may read a cached initialize-time clientInfo.name, never live connection state) so M0 can keep the #542/#539 fix without violating the rule.
